Afghanistan to host India for T20I series in Delhi

Afghanistan will host India for a three-match T20I series in Delhi. The series is scheduled to take place from September 13 to September 17, 2026. The Board of Control for Cricket in India (BCCI) confirmed the series. This contest will serve as preparation for India's Asian Games squad, providing players with T20I game time and an opportunity to assess combinations.
